messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated inference 5xxs from az1a. Service=redwood-inference-runtime. Symptom=GRPC stream errors and nvme/io wait. Severity=P2. Runbook: <https://runbooks.internal/az1a-network>
mia_oncall: oncall ack — I'm taking this pager, investigating impact and mitigation.
dave_sre: looking at host metrics now. seeing rx drops on eni, tx_queue_len congestion, and IO wait spikes on g5s. attaching top-level graph: `rx_drop_rate ~ 7%`, `iowait > 40%`.
eng-runtime: logs show repeated GPU attach failures around the same window: `Device attach failed: -16` and `nvme_io_wait=0.52` on several pods.
mia_oncall: any customer 5xx counts? Are we losing traffic or just latency?
dave_sre: +2.3% 5xx for hosted inference routes in eu-west-az1a starting ~02:14 UTC. Requests succeed when routed to other AZs.
incident-bot: Autopilot: shifted 20% of traffic away from az1a -> eu2b per routing policy (reason: degraded node health).
carla_prodops: drafting customer comms. Proposed msg: "We're seeing degraded performance in a single AZ affecting a subset of inference requests. We're mitigating and rerouting traffic; status page updated." Thoughts?
eng-runtime: temporary mitigation suggestion: disable ephemeral host allocation in az1a to reduce attach churn. Example command: `kubectl patch daemonset ephemeral-host -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"nodeSelector":{"ephemeral":"false"}}}}}'` — will slow new allocs.
dave_sre: starting targeted drain of affected instances: `./tools/drain --az az1a --filter g5 --concurrency 5`.
mia_oncall: plan: 1) continue draining bad hosts 2) monitor K/V cache regen and tail latency 3) escalate to infra/provider if nvme/nic resets persist. Assign: @carla -> customer updates, @eng-runtime -> deeper root cause.
carla_prodops: Posted status page update and emailed 5 active customers with affected keys. Will escalate if impact widens.
eng-runtime: kernel logs show NIC resets: `e1000e 0000:04:00.0: Reset adapter` and `nvme0: I/O 0 QID 1 timeout`. Opening case with cloud provider.
provider-bot: AWS case opened: Case# 12345678. Engaging network team — ETA initial response 25m.
dave_sre: drains are 40% complete. 5xx rate trending down to 0.6% after traffic shift. Continuing to monitor for NVMe errors.
mia_oncall: handing off to night oncall @noah_oncall for continued monitoring and follow-through with AWS case. Noah, I'll stay until you've validated traffic is stable.
noah_oncall: taking over. I'll run the post-drain checks and keep the status page updated. If 5xx creeps above 1% I'll re-escalate.
carla_prodops: I'll follow up with customers once provider gives an update. Current customer notes: transient degraded latency, possible request retries.
incident-bot: Incident state -> monitoring. Severity downgraded to P3. Please use runbook section 'monitoring -> closure' for next steps.
mia_oncall: handoff complete — last check: traffic shifted, drains progressing, AWS investigating NVMe/NIC resets. Closing my watch.
noah_oncall: acknowledged. continuing monitoring and will update thread with AWS case progress.
